attorneys: Petitioners pro se. Solicitor General Rankin, Assistant Attorney General Anderson and Beatrice Rosenberg for the United States.

opinions.text:
Motion for leave to proceed on typewritten papers granted. Motion to defer consideration of petition for certiorari and petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit denied.

Mr. Justice Stewart took no part in the consideration or decision of these applications.
